about.description:
kerneless provides header-only C/C++ implementations of SPICE-compatible
UTC/ET time conversion (kerneless/utcet.h) and DSK type-2 reading
(kerneless/dsk_reader.h), plus Python bindings. The headers are installed
to <prefix>/include/kerneless/ for C and C++ consumers.
about.summary: SPICE-compatible time conversion and DSK reading with no SPICE kernels or toolkit

script.content:
import kerneless

for name in ("calendarTimeToEphemTime", "ephemTimeToCalendarTime",
             "DskFile", "DlaDescriptor", "DskDescriptor"):
    assert hasattr(kerneless, name), name

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: kerneless
  version: "1.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/DOI-USGS/kerneless/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a68b0e2f506cd81e8e27f27be1e3d49301bdf15a7bb83d6582d9f38b749b40c5

build:
  number: 2
  # setup.py installs the headers to <prefix>/include/kerneless/ via data_files.
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=45
    - wheel
    - pybind11 >=2.6.0
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - kerneless
      pip_check: true

  # The headers land in the include prefix, and only there.
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/kerneless/utcet.h
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/kerneless/dsk_reader.h
          - test ! -e $SP_DIR/include
        else:
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\include\kerneless\utcet.h exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\include\kerneless\dsk_reader.h exit 1
          - if exist %SP_DIR%\include exit 1

  # The bindings expose the full API. Behaviour is tested upstream against
  # NAIF SPICE before each release.
  - script:
      interpreter: python
      content: |
        import kerneless

        for name in ("calendarTimeToEphemTime", "ephemTimeToCalendarTime",
                     "DskFile", "DlaDescriptor", "DskDescriptor"):
            assert hasattr(kerneless, name), name

        for name in ("close", "dlabfs", "dlafns", "segments", "dskgd",
                     "dskz02", "dskv02", "dskp02", "__enter__", "__exit__"):
            assert hasattr(kerneless.DskFile, name), "DskFile." + name
